package httpapi

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	"github.com/dronm/ds/v4"
	"github.com/dronm/modelbind"
	"github.com/dronm/modelbind/access"
	"github.com/dronm/modelbind/pg"
	"github.com/dronm/modelbind/types"
	"github.com/dronm/session"
	"github.com/dronm/webapp"

	"example.com/project/internal/models"
	"example.com/project/internal/services"
)

type captureConn struct {
	ds.Conn
	queries []string
	params  [][]any
}
type captureResult struct{ ds.ExecResult }

func (captureResult) RowsAffected() int64 { return 1 }
func (c *captureConn) Exec(_ context.Context, sql string, args ...any) (ds.ExecResult, error) {
	c.queries = append(c.queries, sql)
	c.params = append(c.params, append([]any(nil), args...))
	return captureResult{}, nil
}

type publisher struct{ ordinary, scoped int }

func (p *publisher) PublishEvent(string, string, any) error { p.ordinary++; return nil }

type scopedPublisher struct{ publisher }

func (p *scopedPublisher) PublishAccessEvent(context.Context, webapp.Principal, string, webapp.ServiceMethodEvent) error {
	p.scoped++
	return nil
}

var registerOnce sync.Once

func controller(t *testing.T) *webapp.AccessController {
	t.Helper()
	r := webapp.NewPolicyRegistry()
	if err := services.RegisterAccessModels(r); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for _, resource := range []string{"Order", "TransportOrder", "OrderLine", "HiddenOrder"} {
		for _, operation := range []access.Operation{access.Read, access.Insert, access.Update, access.Delete} {
			if err := r.RegisterRole("customer", resource, operation, func(_ context.Context, p webapp.Principal) (access.Policy, error) {
				owner := p.Claims["customer_id"]
				if operation == access.Insert {
					return access.ForInsert(access.WriteRules{"owner": access.Enforce(owner)}), nil
				}
				policy := access.Scope(access.Eq("owner", owner))
				if operation == access.Update {
					policy.Writes = access.WriteRules{"owner": access.Enforce(owner)}
				}
				return policy, nil
			}); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
	}
	return &webapp.AccessController{Registry: r, ResolvePrincipal: func(context.Context, session.Session) (webapp.Principal, error) {
		return webapp.Principal{UserID: "7", Roles: []string{"customer"}, Claims: map[string]any{"customer_id": int64(42)}}, nil
	}}
}
func scopedContext(t *testing.T) context.Context {
	t.Helper()
	return webapp.ContextWithAccess(context.Background(), controller(t))
}
func setup(t *testing.T) (*captureConn, *webapp.AccessController, http.Handler) {
	t.Helper()
	registerOnce.Do(services.RegisterGeneratedServices)
	conn := &captureConn{}
	services.AccessTestConn = conn
	c := controller(t)
	routes := []webapp.Route{}
	group := webapp.NewGroup("", &routes)
	registerGeneratedRoutes(&group)
	return conn, c, webapp.MustBuildRouter(&webapp.AppContext{Access: c}, routes)
}
func request(handler http.Handler, method, path, body string) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	r := httptest.NewRequest(method, path, strings.NewReader(body))
	r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	handler.ServeHTTP(response, r)
	return response
}

func TestGeneratedMarkersAndExplicitBindings(t *testing.T) {
	c := controller(t)
	ctx := webapp.ContextWithAccess(context.Background(), c)
	for _, model := range []types.DBModel{models.Order{}, &models.Order{}, models.OrderOverview{}, &models.OrderOverview{}, models.OrderDetails{}, &models.OrderDetails{}, models.OrderKey{}, &models.OrderKey{}} {
		if model.(types.AccessScopedModel).AccessResource() != "Order" {
			t.Fatal(model)
		}
		resolved, err := webapp.ResolveModelAccess(ctx, model, access.Read)
		if err != nil || !resolved.Applied {
			t.Fatal(model, err)
		}
		expected := "customer_id"
		if model.Relation() == "public.orders AS o" {
			expected = "o.customer_id"
		}
		if resolved.Binding.Rows["owner"] != expected {
			t.Fatal(resolved.Binding)
		}
		if _, base := model.(models.Order); !base {
			if _, basePointer := model.(*models.Order); !basePointer && len(resolved.Binding.Writes) != 0 {
				t.Fatal("readonly write binding", model)
			}
		}
	}
	for _, key := range []types.DBModel{models.OrderLineKey{}, &models.OrderLineKey{}} {
		if _, err := webapp.ResolveModelAccess(ctx, key, access.Delete); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if err := services.RegisterAccessModels(c.Registry); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "resource") {
		t.Fatal("duplicate registration was not reported", err)
	}
	if err := services.RegisterAccessModels(nil); !errors.Is(err, webapp.ErrAccessConfiguration) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func TestGeneratedHTTPRequiredOwnershipBeforeValidation(t *testing.T) {
	conn, _, handler := setup(t)
	response := request(handler, http.MethodPost, "/transport-orders", `{"id":1,"name":"created"}`)
	if response.Code != http.StatusCreated {
		t.Fatalf("%d: %s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	input := services.AccessTestLastCreate
	if input.Model.CustomerID == nil || *input.Model.CustomerID != 42 || !input.IsPresent("customer_id") {
		t.Fatalf("ineffective policy input: %+v", input)
	}
	if len(conn.queries) != 1 || !strings.Contains(conn.queries[0], "customer_id") {
		t.Fatal(conn.queries)
	}
	for _, body := range []string{`{"id":1,"name":"created","customer_id":99}`, `{"id":1,"name":"created","customer_id":null}`, `{"id":1,"name":"created","customer_id":0}`} {
		response = request(handler, http.MethodPost, "/transport-orders", body)
		if response.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
			t.Fatalf("%s -> %d %s", body, response.Code, response.Body.String())
		}
	}
	response = request(handler, http.MethodPost, "/transport-orders", `{"id":1}`)
	if response.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || len(conn.queries) != 1 {
		t.Fatal(response.Code, conn.queries)
	}
	// Preparing effective input never mutates the original typed body/absence.
	original, err := modelbind.DecodeJSONBodyInput[*models.Order](strings.NewReader(`{"id":1,"name":"new"}`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	effective, err := webapp.PrepareAccessInput(scopedContext(t), original, access.Insert)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if original.Model.CustomerID != nil || !original.IsAbsent("customer_id") || !effective.IsPresent("customer_id") {
		t.Fatal("presence mutation")
	}
}

func TestGeneratedPathUpdatePreservesZeroNullAndAbsence(t *testing.T) {
	conn, _, handler := setup(t)
	response := request(handler, http.MethodPatch, "/transport-orders/5", `{"name":"changed","priority":0,"note":null}`)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
		t.Fatalf("%d %s", response.Code, response.Body.String())
	}
	input := services.AccessTestLastUpdate
	if !input.IsAbsent("customer_id") || !input.IsPresent("priority") || input.Model.Priority != 0 || !input.IsPresent("note") || input.Model.Note != nil {
		t.Fatalf("bad update presence: %+v", input)
	}
	if len(conn.queries) != 1 {
		t.Fatal(conn.queries)
	}
	sql := conn.queries[0]
	where := strings.Index(sql, " WHERE ")
	if where < 0 || strings.Contains(sql[:where], "customer_id") || !strings.Contains(sql[where:], "customer_id") || !strings.Contains(sql[where:], "id =") {
		t.Fatal(sql)
	}
	for _, body := range []string{`{"customer_id":null}`, `{"customer_id":99}`} {
		response = request(handler, http.MethodPatch, "/transport-orders/5", body)
		if response.Code != http.StatusForbidden {
			t.Fatal(response.Code, response.Body.String())
		}
	}
	if len(conn.queries) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("rejected update executed SQL")
	}
	// Key validation cannot be supplied or bypassed by a row policy.
	r := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPatch, "/transport-orders/", strings.NewReader(`{"name":"bad"}`)).WithContext(scopedContext(t))
	r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	if _, err := transportOrderAccessUpdateBinder()(r); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("missing path key accepted")
	}
	r.SetPathValue("orderID", "0")
	if _, err := transportOrderAccessUpdateBinder()(r); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("zero path key accepted")
	}
}

func TestGeneratedCompositePathBinder(t *testing.T) {
	r := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPatch, "/order-lines/2/3", strings.NewReader(`{"name":"changed"}`)).WithContext(scopedContext(t))
	r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	r.SetPathValue("document", "2")
	r.SetPathValue("line", "3")
	decoded, err := orderLineAccessUpdateBinder()(r)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	input := decoded.(webapp.UpdateByKeysInput[*models.OrderLineKey, *models.OrderLine])
	if input.Keys.DocumentID != 2 || input.Keys.LineNum != 3 || !input.Input.IsAbsent("customer_id") {
		t.Fatal(input)
	}
	r = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPatch, "/order-lines/2", strings.NewReader(`{"name":"bad"}`)).WithContext(scopedContext(t))
	r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	r.SetPathValue("document", "2")
	if _, err := orderLineAccessUpdateBinder()(r); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("partial composite path accepted")
	}
}

func TestGeneratedJSONDecodersMatchHandwrittenAndGeneratedSignatures(t *testing.T) {
	conn, c, _ := setup(t)
	ctx := webapp.ContextWithAccess(context.Background(), c)
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		method, body string
		expected     any
	}{
		{"Create", `{"id":1,"name":"created"}`, modelbind.ModelInput[models.TransportOrder]{}},
		{"Update", `{"keys":{"id":1},"input":{"name":"patched","priority":0,"note":null}}`, webapp.UpdateByKeysInput[models.TransportOrderKey, *models.TransportOrder]{}},
		{"Submit", `{"id":1,"name":"created"}`, modelbind.ModelInput[*models.TransportOrder]{}},
		{"Patch", `{"id":1,"name":"patched"}`, modelbind.ModelInput[*models.TransportOrder]{}},
		{"Whole", `{"id":1,"name":"created"}`, (*models.TransportOrder)(nil)},
		{"WholeValue", `{"id":1,"name":"created"}`, models.TransportOrder{}},
		{"ReplaceValue", `{"keys":{"id":1},"input":{"name":"patched"}}`, webapp.UpdateByKeysInput[models.TransportOrderKey, models.TransportOrder]{}},
	} {
		input, err := webapp.DecodeInputForServiceContext(ctx, "TransportOrder", tc.method, json.RawMessage(tc.body))
		if err != nil || reflect.TypeOf(input) != reflect.TypeOf(tc.expected) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %T %v", tc.method, input, err)
		}
		if _, err := webapp.CallServiceJSON(context.Background(), "TransportOrder", tc.method, json.RawMessage(tc.body), webapp.ServiceContext{Access: c}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(tc.method, err)
		}
	}
	if len(conn.queries) != 7 {
		t.Fatal(conn.queries)
	}
	// Standard generated pointer signatures and composite JSON keys also decode.
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		service, method, body string
		expected              any
	}{
		{"Order", "Create", `{"id":1,"name":"created"}`, modelbind.ModelInput[*models.Order]{}},
		{"Order", "Update", `{"keys":{"id":1},"input":{"name":"changed"}}`, webapp.UpdateByKeysInput[*models.OrderKey, *models.Order]{}},
		{"OrderLine", "Update", `{"keys":{"document_id":2,"line_num":3},"input":{"name":"changed"}}`, webapp.UpdateByKeysInput[*models.OrderLineKey, *models.OrderLine]{}},
	} {
		decoded, err := webapp.DecodeInputForServiceContext(ctx, tc.service, tc.method, json.RawMessage(tc.body))
		if err != nil || reflect.TypeOf(decoded) != reflect.TypeOf(tc.expected) {
			t.Fatalf("%s.%s: %T %v", tc.service, tc.method, decoded, err)
		}
	}
	for _, body := range []string{`{"keys":{},"input":{"name":"x"}}`, `{"keys":{"document_id":1},"input":{"name":"x"}}`} {
		if _, err := webapp.DecodeInputForServiceContext(ctx, "OrderLine", "Update", json.RawMessage(body)); !errors.Is(err, modelbind.ErrMissingKey) {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	for _, body := range []string{`{"Model":{"id":1,"name":"x"},"AbsentFields":{}}`, `{"id":1,"name":"x","customer_id":99,"AbsentFields":{"customer_id":true}}`} {
		if _, err := webapp.DecodeInputForServiceContext(ctx, "TransportOrder", "Create", json.RawMessage(body)); err == nil {
			t.Fatal("internal envelope/presence override accepted")
		}
	}
	definition, err := webapp.LookupService("Order")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(definition.InputDecoders) != 2 || definition.InputDecoders["Delete"] != nil || definition.InputDecoders["Detail"] != nil {
		t.Fatal("read/delete keys classified as write bodies")
	}
}

func TestGeneratedServicesFailClosedWithoutAuthorizationContext(t *testing.T) {
	// A nonnil Provider whose methods panic if touched. Missing authorization
	// must be caught by the real helper before asking for a DB connection.
	s := services.OrderService{DB: struct{ ds.Provider }{}}
	owner := 42
	body := modelbind.ModelInput[*models.Order]{Model: &models.Order{ID: 1, CustomerID: &owner, Name: "x"}}
	checks := []func() error{
		func() error { _, err := s.Create(context.Background(), body); return err },
		func() error {
			_, err := s.Update(context.Background(), webapp.UpdateByKeysInput[*models.OrderKey, *models.Order]{Keys: &models.OrderKey{ID: 1}, Input: body})
			return err
		},
		func() error { _, err := s.Delete(context.Background(), 1); return err },
		func() error { _, err := s.Detail(context.Background(), 1); return err },
		func() error { _, err := s.List(context.Background(), modelbind.CollectionParams{}); return err },
	}
	for _, check := range checks {
		if err := check(); !errors.Is(err, webapp.ErrAccessConfiguration) {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
}

func TestGeneratedMissingIdentityRegistrationOrPolicyDeniesBeforeSQL(t *testing.T) {
	conn, c, _ := setup(t)
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name    string
		control *webapp.AccessController
		want    int
	}{
		{"missing controller", nil, http.StatusInternalServerError},
		{"missing principal", &webapp.AccessController{Registry: c.Registry}, http.StatusUnauthorized},
		{"missing registration", &webapp.AccessController{Registry: webapp.NewPolicyRegistry(), ResolvePrincipal: c.ResolvePrincipal}, http.StatusInternalServerError},
		{"no applicable role", &webapp.AccessController{Registry: c.Registry, ResolvePrincipal: func(context.Context, session.Session) (webapp.Principal, error) {
			return webapp.Principal{UserID: "other", Roles: []string{"unassigned"}}, nil
		}}, http.StatusForbidden},
		{"missing policy", func() *webapp.AccessController {
			r := webapp.NewPolicyRegistry()
			if err := services.RegisterAccessModels(r); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			return &webapp.AccessController{Registry: r, ResolvePrincipal: c.ResolvePrincipal}
		}(), http.StatusInternalServerError},
	} {
		routes := []webapp.Route{}
		g := webapp.NewGroup("", &routes)
		registerGeneratedRoutes(&g)
		h := webapp.MustBuildRouter(&webapp.AppContext{Access: tc.control}, routes)
		response := request(h, http.MethodPost, "/transport-orders", `{"id":1,"name":"x"}`)
		if response.Code != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %d %s", tc.name, response.Code, response.Body.String())
		}
	}
	if len(conn.queries) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("failed authorization reached SQL")
	}
}

func TestGeneratedHiddenColumnsReachPolicyAwareCRUD(t *testing.T) {
	conn := &captureConn{}
	input, err := modelbind.DecodeJSONBodyInput[*models.HiddenOrder](strings.NewReader(`{"id":1,"name":"hidden"}`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := webapp.InsertModelInputWithConn(scopedContext(t), conn, input, nil); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(conn.queries) != 1 || !strings.Contains(conn.queries[0], "customer_id") {
		t.Fatal(conn.queries)
	}
	found := false
	for _, value := range conn.params[0] {
		if value == int64(42) {
			found = true
		}
	}
	if !found {
		t.Fatal("hidden write value missing", conn.params)
	}
	model := &models.OrderOverview{}
	resolved, err := webapp.ResolveModelAccess(scopedContext(t), model, access.Read)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	selectBuilder := pg.NewPgSelect(model, nil, nil, nil)
	selectBuilder.AddField("name", &model.Name)
	if err := resolved.ApplyTo(selectBuilder); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	args := []any{}
	sql, err := selectBuilder.BuildSQL(&args)
	if err != nil || !strings.Contains(sql, "o.customer_id") {
		t.Fatal(sql, err)
	}
}

func TestGeneratedNotificationsDoNotRestoreUnrestrictedBroadcasts(t *testing.T) {
	_, c, _ := setup(t)
	ordinary := &publisher{}
	if _, err := webapp.CallServiceJSON(context.Background(), "TransportOrder", "Create", json.RawMessage(`{"id":1,"name":"x"}`), webapp.ServiceContext{Access: c, EventPublisher: ordinary}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if ordinary.ordinary != 0 {
		t.Fatal("protected notification broadcast without access-aware publisher")
	}
	scoped := &scopedPublisher{}
	if _, err := webapp.CallServiceJSON(context.Background(), "TransportOrder", "Create", json.RawMessage(`{"id":1,"name":"x"}`), webapp.ServiceContext{Access: c, EventPublisher: scoped}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if scoped.ordinary != 0 || scoped.scoped != 1 {
		t.Fatal("access-aware publisher was not used", scoped)
	}
}
